description: Find compatible HELLO CYCLING pickup and return stations with timestamped counts and published pricing.

novel_features.name: Nearby availability
novel_features.description: Find nearby pickup or return choices while retaining closed, empty, full, stale and unknown states.

novel_features.name: Compatible trip endpoints
novel_features.description: Compare pickup and dropoff pairs with per-type return capacity and straight-line access distances.

novel_features.name: Explicit offline snapshots
novel_features.description: Save a provider snapshot for offline station discovery with original source timestamps.

novel_features.name: Snapshot changes
novel_features.description: Inspect count and operational changes since an explicitly saved snapshot.

novel_features.name: Regional model pricing
novel_features.description: Read current source tables including municipal exceptions without asserting a station bike price.
